CSV schema & validation

Numeric, finite, non-negative values only. Packet bytes: 0–65,535; duration: 0–86,400,000 ms; packets/s: 0–10,000,000; failed logins: 0–100,000; unique ports: 0–65,535; outbound: 0–1,000,000,000 KB; ratios: 0–1. Column order may vary. Optional label and scenario columns are ignored during inference.

EVALUATE / MODEL INTELLIGENCE

Evidence behind every alert.

Decision threshold

Lower thresholds find more anomalies and may increase false alarms. This control updates test metrics and re-scores session decisions.

Confusion matrix

Rows = actual class · columns = predicted class

Global feature importance

Impurity-based contribution across the forest; this is not a causal explanation of an individual alert.

Baseline comparison

Same holdout split · fixed threshold 0.50 for every model

MODELACCURACYPRECISIONRECALLF1ROC AUC
What these results mean

Synthetic distributions simplify real networks. These scores demonstrate this experiment only; they do not establish real-world intrusion detection accuracy. The model predicts normal/anomaly, not an attack family. Scenario names describe generation profiles. No automatic blocking or production security guarantee is provided.

BCS501 · SOFTWARE ENGINEERING & PROJECT MANAGEMENT

Intelligent Machine Learning-Based Cybersecurity System Using Synthetic Data for Real-Time Anomaly Detection

A reproducible educational prototype that generates synthetic flow features, trains and evaluates a Random Forest, and performs interactive browser inference with an inspectable alert stream.

Architecture & delivery

  1. Generate

    Seeded synthetic profiles with overlapping feature distributions.

  2. Train & evaluate

    Stratified split; forest and two baseline models; confusion matrix.

  3. Infer & investigate

    Export tree parameters to JSON; score flows in the browser.

  4. Review & report

    Inspect features, acknowledge alerts and export session evidence.

Submission documents

Completed SEPM assignment + project supplement · Completed process-model worksheet

Three-minute demonstration

  1. Start mixed traffic replay and inspect a flagged flow.
  2. Choose a synthetic attack profile and compare its scores.
  3. Open Model intelligence and adjust the decision threshold.
  4. Upload the sample CSV and download its predictions.
  5. Explain the train/test split, false positives and synthetic-data limitation.
